name: HiringNow
summary: AI job-search agent that finds roles on company career pages, tailors your resume to each posting, and auto-applies with your approval.
description: AI job-search agent that finds roles on company career pages, tailors your resume to each posting, and auto-applies with your approval.

pricing.details: Free 0 €, no card — 10 auto-applies one-time, job matches and match score, 1 resume and 1 cover letter, basic templates. Pro 26 €/month (or 53 € a quarter, official example of quarterly billing at about a third less) — 100 auto-applies/month, unlimited resumes and cover letters, premium templates, 1 search profile, top-up packs available. Autopilot 44 €/month — 300 auto-applies/month, everything in Pro, approve each one or in advance by rules, up to 3 search profiles, priority queue and instant alerts. Autopilot Max 90 €/month (billed monthly).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Personal AI job-search agent that finds roles on company career pages
Resume and cover letter tailored per application, plus ATS score
Auto-apply with your approval, job tracker and Chrome autofill
Free plan with no card (10 auto-applies one-time)
